object.description: Setup: three saved workouts of different activity types, distances and durations, saved out of start-time order; distance unit kilometre. Steps: 1. Open the History screen. 2. Read the rows. 3. Set the distance unit to mile and read the rows again. Expected: Rows run from latest to earliest start time; each row shows activity type, start date and time, distance, duration and average pace, with distance and pace converted to miles in step 3.
